transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess what made me come in is that... the things that usually make me feel like myself just aren't doing it anymore. Like, I used to love going on photography walks, and I mentored some kids, and honestly, even just keeping my work calendar organized used to give me some satisfaction. But lately, it all just feels flat. And heavy. I just kind of stopped initiating any of it.
Do you still enjoy the activities you mentioned, like photography walks, or has the pleasure gone away?

Yeah, like I was just saying, the pleasure is pretty much gone. It all just feels... flat now. Taking my camera out or going to mentor the kids used to be the best part of my week, but lately it just feels heavy. There's no joy in it anymore, which is why I've just stopped trying to initiate any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been going on for a while now. I'd say about a year and three months. It really started after a family member of mine... well, their health and behavior started changing pretty significantly, and I had to take on a lot more of the coordination for their care. Since then, it's just been this kind of heavy, flat feeling that hasn't really lifted.
Have you been having any thoughts about death, or wishing you were dead, during this time?
No, no... I haven't had any thoughts like that. I mean, I don't wish I were dead or anything. It's just more of a... a lack of energy and enjoyment in things. But no, no thoughts about dying.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns since you started feeling this way?

Yeah, it actually has changed. Um... there have been nights lately where I really only sleep for maybe two or three hours. I'll just wake up way before dawn, and instead of feeling exhausted like you'd expect, I don't feel tired at all. I actually feel completely ready to go. Like, I'll wake up and feel ready to just start answering my boss's emails or updating appointment lists for work right then and there.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite since you started feeling this way?
No, not really. My appetite has been pretty normal, honestly. I haven't noticed myself eating any more or less than usual, so... yeah, no real changes there.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or the opposite, feeling restless or fidgety?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't think I'm moving or talking any slower than I usually do. And I wouldn't say I feel restless or fidgety, either. I feel pretty normal in that regard, honestly.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
No, not really. I wouldn't say I feel sad. I actually feel pretty good, honestly. So, no, sadness hasn't really been an issue for me lately.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

Well, honestly, that's actually what made me come in. The things that usually make me feel like myself... they just don't right now. Like, I usually enjoy taking photography walks, or mentoring the kids, or even just keeping a clean calendar. But lately, all of that has just started feeling, I don't know, flat. And kind of heavy. I just stopped initiating them altogether. So, no, I'm not really finding much pleasure in those things right now.
Is the lack of pleasure in activities more bothersome to you than the lack of interest in doing them?

I don't know if one is really more bothersome than the other, to be honest. It's kind of all tied together for me. I just know that I don't want to do them, and when I think about doing them, I just don't feel anything good about it. So I wouldn't say one part bothers me more, it's just the whole situation that's frustrating.
Do you feel depressed most of the day?

No, I wouldn't say I feel depressed. Like I mentioned earlier about not feeling sad, my mood itself is actually fine most of the day. It's really just that flat feeling when it comes to my usual activities, but no... I definitely don't walk around feeling depressed.
Do you have any interest in doing things you used to enjoy?

Like I was saying a minute ago, no, not really. That's honestly the main reason I came in to see you. The drive to do the things that usually make me feel like myself—going on my photography walks, mentoring the kids, even just keeping a clean calendar—the interest just isn't there right now. The thought of doing them just feels flat and heavy, so I've completely stopped initiating any of it.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?

No, not really. Like I was just mentioning, that's exactly what made me come in to see you. The things that usually make me feel like myself—the photography walks, mentoring the kids, keeping my calendar in order—they all just started feeling flat and heavy. Since I stopped initiating those, there really hasn't been anything else I look forward to or get any pleasure out of.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
No, not that I've noticed. My weight has stayed pretty much the same... I haven't had any big drops or anything like that.
Do you often feel guilty or worthless about things that have happened?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I feel down about not doing my usual stuff, but I don't really sit around feeling guilty or... or like I'm worthless. It's more just that heavy, flat feeling I mentioned, rather than feeling bad about myself as a person.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in most things most of the day?

Yeah, I think so. Like I was saying before, the things I used to enjoy just don't do anything for me right now. It's pretty much an all-day thing. I just don't have the interest or the energy to care about much of anything anymore.
Do you feel like you're in a depressed mood for most of the day?

No, not really. I don't feel sad or... or down in the dumps most of the day, if that's what you mean. Like I said, it's more of just a flat feeling where I just don't care about much. But I wouldn't say my actual mood is depressed.
Do you feel like you're in a low mood for most of the day?
Like I was just saying, no, not really. I don't feel low or sad. It's really just that flat feeling I mentioned where I just don't have the energy for things. So, no, I wouldn't call it a low mood.
Do you feel like you're in a depressed mood?
I feel like we just went over this, but... no. I'm really not in a depressed mood. Like I said, I don't feel sad, it's just that flat feeling.
Do you feel like you are depressed?

I... look, I really don't know how else to say it. No, I am not depressed. We keep going in circles on this, but my answer is still the same. It's just that flat feeling I told you about, not depression.
